definitions.explanation: A large beetle with distinctive mandibles that resemble deer antlers. Popular among Japanese children as collectible insects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧クワガタムシ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえた→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧。
examples.english: I caught a stag beetle in the mountains during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: クワガタムシ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜行性|やこうせい}→夜行性：16217_yakousei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧クワガタムシ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}いたがっている→飼う：08151_kau⟧。
examples.english: My son wants to keep a stag beetle as a pet.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
The name comes from ⟦{鍬形|くわがた}→鍬形：noentry⟧ (hoe-shaped decoration on samurai helmets) + ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ (insect), referring to the beetle's large mandibles that resemble this decoration.

ABBREVIATION:
Often shortened to ⟦クワガタ→クワガタ：05130_kuwagata⟧ in casual speech.

POPULAR HOBBY:
Collecting and raising stag beetles (⟦{昆虫|こんちゅう}{採集|さいしゅう}→昆虫採集：28686_konchuusaishuu⟧) is a beloved summer activity for Japanese children. They are often kept alongside ⟦カブトムシ→カブトムシ：05199_kabutomushi⟧ (rhinoceros beetles).

COMMON SPECIES:
・⟦オオクワガタ→オオクワガタ：noentry⟧ (giant stag beetle) - the most prized species
・⟦ノコギリクワガタ→ノコギリクワガタ：noentry⟧ (saw stag beetle)
・⟦ミヤマクワガタ→ミヤマクワガタ：noentry⟧ (deep mountain stag beetle)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・クワガタムシ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ (to keep a stag beetle)
・クワガタムシ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧ (to catch a stag beetle)
・クワガタムシ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幼虫|ようちゅう}→幼虫：16411_youchuu⟧ (stag beetle larva)
・クワガタムシ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧ (stag beetle food - usually tree sap or jelly)
